title: WELCOME PACK: ONE LINE INTRO
why: Critic b-31 on the welcome pack (02): the four sentence intro paragraph is an explaining sentence over the pack list. Shortened under his Q8, reason in changes.md.
now: The welcome pack intro is one short line.

edits.anchor: A few things to play with before your first climb, straight into your stash: a green gun and a blue one, heals, plates and grenades. Nothing here is bought. It is yours for turning up. Take it, or close this and go without; it is offered once.
edits.replacement: free, once. take it or go without.
